subject: Re: IME kickoff - staffing + synthetic-data pipeline build
body:
Dmitri,

Resourcing:

- Staffing: Kaia 60%, Amara 60%, Efe 30% through the window.
- Compute: trivial by portfolio standards - these train on single GPUs, so a small titan-a100 best-effort slice covers everything including sweeps over utilization_hp and smoothness_hp.

The substantial build: for the internal-workload eval we can't move the real forecasting data across privacy boundaries on our timeline (Kofi's review SLA is 2-3 weeks and the data owner wants scoping first). So we're scoping and staffing a synthetic-data generation pipeline from scratch - regime-switching time series with configurable seasonality, trend breaks, and covariate structure that mimics the internal workload's statistics without containing any real records. Amara owns the build at 60% for about six weeks, with Kaia specifying the regime structure. It doubles as the stress-test bed: we can dial regime overlap and see exactly where single-expert assignment breaks.

Nothing else exotic. Budget-neutral.

Jelena
